newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 breaks 4,000 barrier in pre-market.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 breaks 4,000 barrier in pre-market.

text.p: Leading UK shares surged through the 4,000 barrier in pre-market trading on Wednesday, continuing Tuesday's late surge and cutting through the psychologically important level.
By 0709 GMT, the FTSE 100 was trading at 4,002.6, a rise of 10.4 points, topping its previous best of 3,994.1 set on September 20.
